info.name: Awan
info.description:
# Awan (EZDO) API

Smart Productivity & Task Management Backend.

## Base URL

`http://localhost:8080/api/v1`

## Authentication

- **OTP-based email authentication** – no passwords.
- Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` header.
- Access tokens expire after 24 hours. Use refresh token rotation to get new ones.
- On `401` responses: `TOKEN_EXPIRED` means the access token has expired - refresh via the refresh token.
  `TOKEN_INVALID` or `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` means the token is missing/invalid - re-authenticate.

## Error Response Format

All errors return a consistent JSON structure:
```json
{
  "message": "Human-readable message",
  "statusCode": 400,
  "errorCode": "ERROR_CODE",
  "info": {},
  "timestamp": "2024-01-01T12:00:00"
}
```

Validation errors include field-level details in `info.errors`:
```json
{
  "info": {
    "errors": [
      {"field": "email", "message": "must be a well-formed email address", "rejectedValue": "bad"}
    ]
  }
}
```

## Error Codes Reference

| Error Code | HTTP Status | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 422 | Request body validation failed |
| `MALFORMED_REQUEST_BODY` | 400 | Invalid or missing JSON body |
| `MISSING_PARAMETER` | 400 | Required query/param missing |
| `TYPE_MISMATCH` | 400 | Parameter type mismatch |
| `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Endpoint does not exist |
| `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | 405 | HTTP method not supported |
| `MEDIA_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED` | 415 | Unsupported Content-Type |
| `ACCESS_DENIED` | 403 | No permission |
| `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` | 401 | Missing or unverifiable JWT - re-authenticate |
| `TOKEN_EXPIRED` | 401 | Access token expired - refresh via refresh token |
| `TOKEN_INVALID` | 401 | Access token malformed/invalid - re-login |
| `OTP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | 429 | Too many OTP requests (3 per 10min) |
| `OTP_EXPIRED_OR_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | OTP code expired / invalid email |
| `OTP_INVALID_CODE` | 401 | Wrong OTP code |
| `OTP_LOCKED` | 423 | Too many wrong attempts (max 5) |
| `REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID` | 401 | Refresh token not found |
| `REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRED` | 401 | Refresh token expired |
| `REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSE_DETECTED` | 401 | Token reuse – all sessions revoked |
| `USER_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | User not found |
| `GOAL_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Goal not found / not owned |
| `TASK_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Task not found / not owned |
| `CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Category not found |
| `SESSION_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Session not found / not owned |
| `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Template not found / not owned |
| `TEMPLATE_OVERRIDE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Template override not found / not owned |
| `ZONE_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Zone not found / not owned |
| `GOAL_DECOMPOSITION_SESSION_NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Decomposition session not found / not owned |
| `ONBOARDING_ALREADY_COMPLETED` | 400 | User already onboarded |
| `INVALID_TIMEZONE` | 400 | Invalid timezone string |
| `INVALID_OPERATION` | 400 | Business logic violation |
| `INVALID_DECOMPOSITION` | 400 | Invalid decomposition session state |
| `INVALID_ZONE_TIME_RANGE` | 400 | End time must be after start time |
| `INVALID_SLEEP_SCHEDULE` | 400 | Wake up must be before sleep time |
| `INSUFFICIENT_POINTS` | 400 | Not enough points to deduct |
| `TASK_CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY` | 400 | Dependency would create a cycle |
| `DUPLICATE_TEMP_ID` | 400 | Duplicate tempId in batch |
| `UNKNOWN_TEMP_ID` | 400 | Referenced tempId not found in batch |
| `DAY_ALREADY_ASSIGNED` | 409 | Day(s) already belong to another weekly template |
| `ZONE_OVERLAP` | 409 | Zone time range overlaps with an existing zone |
| `DATA_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION` | 409 | Database constraint violation |
| `AI_UNAVAILABLE` | 503 | AI service is temporarily unavailable |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected server error |

## Collection Variables

| Variable | Default Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `baseUrl` | `http://localhost:8080/api` | Base URL (full path: `/api/v1/...`) |
| `accessToken` | (empty) | Set after OTP Verify or Refresh |

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
OTP-based email authentication. No password required. Flow: Request OTP → Verify OTP → Use access token.

**Refresh Token Rotation:**
- Each refresh invalidates the old token and issues a new pair.
- If a revoked token is reused, ALL tokens for that user are revoked (compromise detection).
- Store the new `refreshToken` after every refresh call.

request.description:
Request a one-time password (OTP) sent via email.

**Request Body:**
- `email` (string, required) – Valid email address.

**Response (200):**
- `expiresInSeconds` (int) – OTP validity duration (default 300s = 5 min).
- `resendAvailableInSeconds` (int) – Cooldown before next request (default 30s).

**Possible Errors:**
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Invalid email format.
- `OTP_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` (429) – Max 3 requests per 10 minutes.

Verify OTP code to authenticate. Creates a new user if first-time, or logs in existing user.

**Request Body:**
- `email` (string, required) – Email that received the OTP.
- `code` (string, required) – Exactly 6 digits.
- `deviceId` (UUID, required) – Unique device identifier (client-generated, persist locally).

**Response (200):**
- `accessToken` (string) – JWT for Bearer auth.
- `accessTokenExpiresIn` (long) – Seconds until access token expires (default 86400 = 24h).
- `refreshToken` (string) – For token rotation. Store securely.
- `user` (object):
  - `id` (UUID) – User ID.
  - `email` (string) – User email.
  - `isNew` (boolean) – `true` if first login (must complete onboarding).

**Possible Errors:**
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Invalid email/code format.
- `OTP_EXPIRED_OR_NOT_FOUND` (404) – Code expired (5 min) or never requested.
- `OTP_INVALID_CODE` (401) – Wrong code.
- `OTP_LOCKED` (423) – Max 5 wrong attempts for this email.

Rotate refresh token to get a new access token.

**Request Body:**
- `refreshToken` (string, required) – The current refresh token.
- `deviceId` (UUID, required) – Must match the deviceId used during OTP verify.

**Response (200):**
- `accessToken` (string) – New JWT.
- `accessTokenExpiresIn` (long) – Seconds until expiry (default 86400).
- `refreshToken` (string) – **New** refresh token (previous one is revoked).

**Possible Errors:**
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Invalid input.
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID` (401) – Token not found in DB.
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRED` (401) – Token expired (30 days).
- `REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSE_DETECTED` (401) – Token already used → ALL tokens revoked.

Logout by revoking the refresh token for the given device.

**Request Body:**
- `deviceId` (UUID, required) – The device to log out from.

**Response:** `204 No Content`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid access token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Invalid deviceId.

item.name: Onboarding
item.description:
First-time user setup. Must be completed when `isNew: true` is returned from OTP Verify.

Once completed, the user's `isNew` flag is set to `false`. Subsequent calls will fail with `ONBOARDING_ALREADY_COMPLETED`.

request.description:
Complete initial onboarding for new users.

**Request Body:**
- `firstName` (string, required) – Max 50 chars.
- `lastName` (string, required) – Max 50 chars.
- `birthDate` (LocalDate, required) – Must be in the past. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `timezone` (string, required) – IANA timezone (e.g., `Africa/Cairo`, `America/New_York`).
- `preferredSessionDuration` (int, required) – Minutes per session (must be ≥ 0).
- `bufferBetweenSessions` (int, required) – Minutes between sessions (must be ≥ 0).
- `wakeupTime` (LocalTime, required) – Wake-up time. Format: `HH:mm:ss`.
- `sleepTime` (LocalTime, required) – Bed time. Format: `HH:mm:ss`.
- `schedulingType` (enum, optional) – Default: `BALANCED`. Options: `BALANCED`, `EASIEST_FIRST`, `HARDEST_FIRST`.

**Response (200):** `UserProfileResponse` (see Get Profile).

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid access token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Missing/invalid fields.
- `ONBOARDING_ALREADY_COMPLETED` (400) – User already onboarded.
- `INVALID_TIMEZONE` (400) – Invalid timezone string.
- `INVALID_SLEEP_SCHEDULE` (400) – `wakeupTime` must be before `sleepTime`.

item.name: User
item.description: User profile, preferences, and gamification (points/streak) management.

request.description:
Get the authenticated user's full profile and preferences.

**Query Parameters:** None.

**Response (200):** `UserProfileResponse`
- `id` (UUID) – User ID.
- `email` (string) – Email address.
- `firstName` (string or null) – First name.
- `lastName` (string or null) – Last name.
- `birthDate` (LocalDate or null) – Date of birth.
- `points` (int) – Total earned points.
- `streak` (int) – Current streak count.
- `maxStreak` (int) – Highest streak ever.
- `preferences` (object):
  - `timezone` (string) – IANA timezone.
  - `preferredSessionDuration` (int) – Minutes per session.
  - `bufferBetweenSessions` (int) – Minutes between sessions.
  - `wakeupTime` (LocalTime) – Wake-up time.
  - `sleepTime` (LocalTime) – Bed time.
  - `schedulingType` (string) – `BALANCED`, `EASIEST_FIRST`, or `HARDEST_FIRST`.

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid access token.
- `USER_NOT_FOUND` (404) – User not found (should not happen if token is valid).

Check if the user account is new (onboarding not yet completed).

**Query Parameters:** None.

**Response (200):** `Map<string, boolean>`
- `isNew` (boolean) – `true` if onboarding is incomplete, `false` otherwise.

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid access token.
- `USER_NOT_FOUND` (404) – User not found.

Update the user's first and last name.

**Request Body:**
- `firstName` (string, required) – Max 50 chars.
- `lastName` (string, required) – Max 50 chars.

**Response (200):** `UserProfileResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Missing/blank name fields.

Update the user's birth date.

**Request Body:**
- `birthDate` (LocalDate, required) – Must be in the past. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

**Response (200):** `UserProfileResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Missing date or date in the future.

Partially update profile fields. Only provided fields are updated.

**Request Body (all optional):**
- `firstName` (string) – Max 50 chars.
- `lastName` (string) – Max 50 chars.
- `birthDate` (LocalDate) – Must be in the past.
- `timezone` (string) – IANA timezone regex: `^[A-Za-z]+(?:/[A-Za-z_]+)+$`.
- `preferredSessionDuration` (int) – Minutes (≥ 0).
- `bufferBetweenSessions` (int) – Minutes (≥ 0).
- `wakeupTime` (LocalTime) – Format: `HH:mm:ss`.
- `sleepTime` (LocalTime) – Must differ from `wakeupTime`. Format: `HH:mm:ss`.
- `schedulingType` (enum) – `BALANCED`, `EASIEST_FIRST`, `HARDEST_FIRST`.

**Response (200):** `UserProfileResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Request body validation failed.

Update the user's preferred IANA timezone.

**Request Body:**
- `timezone` (string, required) – IANA timezone (e.g., `Africa/Cairo`, `America/New_York`, `Asia/Tokyo`).

**Response (200):** `UserProfileResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Request body validation failed.
- `INVALID_TIMEZONE` (400) – Invalid IANA timezone string.

Update preferred session duration and buffer time.

**Request Body:**
- `preferredSessionDuration` (int, required) – Minutes per session (≥ 10).
- `bufferBetweenSessions` (int, required) – Break minutes between sessions (≥ 0).

**Response (200):** `UserProfileResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Request body validation failed.

Update wake-up and sleep times.

**Request Body:**
- `wakeupTime` (LocalTime, required) – Format: `HH:mm:ss`.
- `sleepTime` (LocalTime, required) – Must be after `wakeupTime`. Format: `HH:mm:ss`.

**Response (200):** `UserProfileResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Request body validation failed.
- `INVALID_SLEEP_SCHEDULE` (400) – Wake up must be before sleep time.

Update the scheduling algorithm type.

**Request Body:**
- `schedulingType` (enum, optional) – Default: `BALANCED`. Options:
  - `BALANCED` – Balance difficulty.
  - `EASIEST_FIRST` – Do easy tasks first.
  - `HARDEST_FIRST` – Do hard tasks first.

**Response (200):** `UserProfileResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.

Increment the user's current streak by 1. If current streak exceeds max streak, max streak is updated.

**Request Body:** None (empty).

**Response (200):** `UserProgressResponse`
- `points` (int) – Total points.
- `streak` (int) – Updated current streak.
- `maxStreak` (int) – Highest streak ever.

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.

Reset the user's current streak to 0. Max streak is preserved.

**Request Body:** None (empty).

**Response (200):** `UserProgressResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.

Award points to the user (adds to total).

**Request Body:**
- `points` (int, required) – Must be positive (> 0).

**Response (200):** `UserProgressResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Points must be positive.

Deduct points from the user (subtracts from total).

**Request Body:**
- `points` (int, required) – Must be positive (> 0).

**Response (200):** `UserProgressResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Points must be positive.
- `INSUFFICIENT_POINTS` (400) – User doesn't have enough points.

item.name: Goals
item.description:
Goal and task management. Goals contain tasks. Each user has an auto-created Inbox goal for unassigned tasks.

**Goal Statuses:** `ACTIVE` (default), `ACHIEVED`.
**Task Statuses:** `SCHEDULED` (default), `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED`.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Learn Spring Boot",
  "description": "Master Spring Boot and build a REST API",
  "targetDate": "2026-12-31",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "tempId": "tmp-1",
      "title": "Study JPA basics",
      "description": "Understand ORM and JPA annotations",
      "estimatedDuration": 60,
      "mandatory": true,
      "estimatedPoints": 30,
      "allowTaskSplitting": false,
      "dependsOnTempIds": [],
      "categoryId": "optional-category-uuid"
    }
  ]
}

request.description:
Create a new goal.

**Request Body:**
- `title` (string, required) – Max 255 chars.
- `description` (string, optional) – Max 2000 chars.
- `targetDate` (LocalDate, optional) – Must be in the future. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `tasks` (array, optional) – Max 50 draft tasks to create with the goal. Each item:
  - `tempId` (string, required) – Client-generated unique ID for cross-referencing dependencies.
  - `title` (string, required) – Max 255 chars.
  - `description` (string, optional) – Max 2000 chars.
  - `estimatedDuration` (int, optional) – Estimated minutes. Defaults to user's `preferredSessionDuration` if not provided (must be ≥ 1 if given).
  - `mandatory` (boolean, optional).
  - `estimatedPoints` (int, optional).
  - `allowTaskSplitting` (boolean, optional).
  - `categoryId` (UUID, optional) – Category to assign.
  - `dependsOnTempIds` (string[], optional) – References to other `tempId`s in the same batch.

**Response (201):** `GoalInfoResponse`
- `id` (UUID) – Goal ID.
- `title` (string) – Goal title.
- `description` (string or null) – Description.
- `status` (string) – `ACTIVE` or `ACHIEVED`.
- `targetDate` (LocalDate or null) – Target completion date.
- `createdAt` (Instant) – Creation timestamp.
- `inbox` (boolean) – Whether this is the Inbox goal.
- `tasks` (array) – List of `TaskInfoResponse` objects.

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Missing title or future date constraint.
- `DUPLICATE_TEMP_ID` (409) – Duplicate tempId in the batch.
- `UNKNOWN_TEMP_ID` (400) – dependsOnTempIds references a non-existent tempId.

request.description:
List user's goals with pagination and filtering.

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | `ACTIVE` / `ACHIEVED` | No | — | Filter by goal status. Omit for all. |
| `includeInbox` | boolean | No | `false` | Include the Inbox goal in results. |
| `expand` | boolean | No | `false` | Include full task objects instead of just task IDs. |
| `page` | int | No | `0` | Page number (0-indexed). |
| `size` | int | No | `20` | Page size (items per page). |
| `sort` | string | No | — | Sort field and direction (e.g., `createdAt,desc`). |

**Response (200):** Spring Data `Page<GoalInfoResponse>`
- `content` (array) – List of goals.
- `totalElements` (long) – Total count.
- `totalPages` (int) – Total pages.
- `number` (int) – Current page number.
- `size` (int) – Page size.
- `first` / `last` (boolean) – Navigation flags.

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `TYPE_MISMATCH` (400) – Invalid enum value for status.

Get the auto-created Inbox goal (tasks without a goal land here). Creates it if it doesn't exist.

**Query Parameters:** None.

**Response (200):** `GoalInfoResponse` (with `inbox: true`)

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.

Get a single goal by ID.

**Path Parameters:**
- `goalId` (UUID, required) – Goal identifier.

**Query Parameters:**
| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `expand` | boolean | No | `false` | Include full task objects instead of just task IDs. |

**Response (200):** `GoalInfoResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `GOAL_NOT_FOUND` (404) – Goal doesn't exist or doesn't belong to user.

List all tasks belonging to a specific goal.

**Path Parameters:**
- `goalId` (UUID, required) – Goal identifier.

**Query Parameters:** None.

**Response (200):** Array of `TaskInfoResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `GOAL_NOT_FOUND` (404) – Goal not found or does not belong to user.

request.description:
Bulk add up to 50 tasks to a goal in one request. Supports cross-reference dependencies via tempIds.

**Path Parameters:**
- `goalId` (UUID, required) – Goal identifier.

**Request Body:**
- `tasks` (array, required) – Max 50 items. Each item:
  - `tempId` (string, required) – Client-generated unique ID for cross-referencing.
  - `title` (string, required) – Max 255 chars.
  - `description` (string, optional) – Max 2000 chars.
  - `estimatedDuration` (int, optional) – Estimated minutes. Defaults to user's `preferredSessionDuration` if not provided (must be ≥ 1 if given).
  - `mandatory` (boolean, optional) – Is mandatory (default: false).
  - `estimatedPoints` (int, optional) – Points on completion (default: 0).
  - `allowTaskSplitting` (boolean, optional) – Can split (default: false).
  - `categoryId` (UUID, optional) – Category to assign.
  - `dependsOnRefs` (string[], optional) – References to tempIds from this batch or real UUIDs of existing tasks in the goal.

**Response (201):** Array of `TaskInfoResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `GOAL_NOT_FOUND` (404) – Goal not found or does not belong to user.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Request body validation failed.
- `TASK_CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY` (400) – Adding this dependency would create a cycle.
- `UNKNOWN_TEMP_ID` (400) – dependsOnRefs references non-existent tempId or task ID.
- `DUPLICATE_TEMP_ID` (409) – Duplicate tempId in the batch.

request.description:
Update an existing goal. Only provided fields are updated.

**Path Parameters:**
- `goalId` (UUID, required) – Goal identifier.

**Request Body (all optional):**
- `title` (string) – Max 255 chars.
- `description` (string) – Max 2000 chars.
- `status` (enum) – `ACTIVE` or `ACHIEVED`.
- `targetDate` (LocalDate) – Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

**Notes:**
- The Inbox goal cannot be edited (will get `INVALID_OPERATION`).

**Response (200):** `GoalInfoResponse`

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT token.
- `GOAL_NOT_FOUND` (404) – Goal not found or does not belong to user.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Request body validation failed.
- `INVALID_OPERATION` (400) – Cannot edit the Inbox.

item.name: Tasks
item.description:
Task CRUD, moving between goals, and dependency management.

**Task Statuses:** `SCHEDULED` (default on create), `IN_PROGRESS`, `COMPLETED`, `CANCELLED`.

**Dependencies:** Tasks can depend on other tasks **within the same goal only**. Circular dependencies are prevented.

request.description:
Get all tasks that have sessions on a specific date. Each task includes only its sessions for that day, sorted by start time ascending.

**Path Parameters:**
- `date` (LocalDate, required) – Target date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

**Response (200):** Array of `TaskWithSessionsResponse`
- `task` (object) – `TaskInfoResponse` (task details, including `category`).
- `sessions` (array) – `SessionResponse[]` for that date.

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT.
- `TYPE_MISMATCH` (400) – Invalid date format.

item.description:
Weekly recurring schedule templates. Each template defines a set of days-of-week it applies to and contains time-block zones.

**Day Conflict Rule:** A day-of-week can only belong to ONE template. Creating/updating a template with a day already assigned to another template is rejected with `DAY_ALREADY_ASSIGNED`.

- `zones` (array, optional) – Max 50 zones. Each item:
  - `name` (string, required) – Zone name.
  - `startTime` (LocalTime, required) – Start time. Format: `HH:mm:ss`.
  - `endTime` (LocalTime, required) – Must be after `startTime`. Format: `HH:mm:ss`.
  - `color` (string, optional) – Hex color code (e.g., `#4CAF50`).

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) – Missing/ invalid fields.
- `DAY_ALREADY_ASSIGNED` (409) – One or more days are already used by another template.
- `INVALID_ZONE_TIME_RANGE` (400) – `endTime` must be after `startTime`.

item.name: AI Scheduling
item.description:
AI-powered scheduling endpoints. The system uses an AI model to intelligently schedule tasks into available time zones, respecting user preferences, task dependencies, and existing booked sessions.

**Scheduling Strategy:** The AI considers:
- User's preferred session duration and buffer time.
- Wake-up and sleep times.
- Available zones (from templates/overrides).
- Existing booked (locked) sessions.
- Task dependencies and priorities.
- Scheduling type: `BALANCED`, `EASIEST_FIRST`, or `HARDEST_FIRST`.

**Failure Reasons for Unscheduled Tasks:**
- `INSUFFICIENT_TIME` – Task duration exceeds available zone capacity.
- `DEPENDENCY_CONFLICT` – A dependency could not be scheduled.
- `NO_SUITABLE_ZONE` – No zone matches the task requirements.
- `EXCEEDS_DAILY_CAPACITY` – Would exceed daily limits.

item.name: AI Goal Decomposition
item.description:
AI-powered conversational goal decomposition. Users chat with an AI assistant to break down a high-level goal into structured tasks with estimates, dependencies, and categories.

**Flow:**
1. Send a message to `/ai/goal-decompose` (first message: set `sessionId` to null).
2. The AI responds with questions, text, or a proposal.
3. Continue the conversation until you get a proposal (blocks contain `type: "proposal"`).
4. Confirm the proposal with `/ai/goal-decompose/{sessionId}/confirm` to create the goal.
5. Cancel anytime with `/ai/goal-decompose/{sessionId}/cancel`.

**Content Block Types (polymorphic):**
- `type: "text"` – Informational message. Fields: `text`.
- `type: "question"` – AI asks for more info. Fields: `text`, `options`.
- `type: "proposal"` – Goal decomposition ready for confirmation. Fields: `proposal` containing:
  - `title` (string) – Goal title.
  - `description` (string) – Goal description.
  - `targetDate` (LocalDate or null) – Suggested target date.
  - `tasks` (array) – Proposed tasks, each with `title`, `description`, `estimatedDuration`, `mandatory`, `estimatedPoints`, `allowTaskSplitting`, `category`, `dependsOnTempIds`.

request.description:
Send a message in the goal decomposition conversation. For the very first message, set `sessionId` to `null` — the server creates a new session and returns its ID.

**Request Body:**
- `sessionId` (UUID or null) – Session ID. `null` starts a new session.
- `message` (string, required) – Your message or answer to the AI's question.

**Response (200):** `ChatReply`
- `sessionId` (UUID) – The session ID (use for subsequent messages).
- `blocks` (array) – Content blocks the AI responded with:
  - `type` (string) – Discriminator: `"text"`, `"question"`, or `"proposal"`.
  - For `type: "text"`: `text` (string).
  - For `type: "question"`: `text` (string), `options` (string[]).
  - For `type: "proposal"`: `proposal` (object with `title`, `description`, `targetDate`, `tasks`).
- `hasProposal` (boolean) – Whether the response contains a proposal.
- `timestamp` (ISO instant) – Response timestamp.

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) – Missing/invalid/expired JWT.
- `AI_UNAVAILABLE` (503) – AI service unavailable.
- `GOAL_DECOMPOSITION_SESSION_NOT_FOUND` (404) – Invalid `sessionId`.
- `INVALID_DECOMPOSITION` (400) – Invalid message or session state.

Create task proposals from a free-form natural language note. The AI analyzes the text against your categories, preferences, and calendar availability, and returns one or more structured task drafts with AI-estimated durations, points, categories, and suggested scheduling.

Nothing is persisted by this endpoint. Each task in the response carries a `draft` that is literally the body to POST to `/api/v1/tasks/with-sessions` to accept that task, so confirming needs no mapping on the client side.

Two independent scheduling channels:
- `draft.sessions` — Timing the source itself stated (e.g. "tomorrow at 3pm") is passed through untouched.
- `aiProposedSessions` — The model’s own suggestion grounded in real availability, with a `reason` explaining the choice.

**Request Body:**
- `text` (string, required) — Free-form natural language note (max 4000 chars). Examples: "Build login page with validation", "Gym Monday and Wednesday 6-8pm, grocery shopping Friday morning".

**Response (200):** `TaskProposalResponse`
- `sourceSummary` (string or null) — Always null for typed notes. Present for image uploads to show what was read from the image.
- `tasks` (array) — Proposed task drafts:
  - `draft` (TaskWithSessionsRequest) — Body to POST to `/api/v1/tasks/with-sessions`:
    - `task` (object): `title`, `description`, `estimatedDuration`, `mandatory`, `estimatedPoints`, `allowTaskSplitting`, `goalId`, `categoryId`.
    - `sessions` (array): Timing from source text — `start` (ISO datetime), `end` (ISO datetime), `zoneId` (UUID or null), `status` = `SCHEDULED`.
  - `aiProposedSessions` (array) — AI-proposed timing, same structure as `draft.sessions`.
  - `reason` (string) — Why the AI proposed those times, or what prevented scheduling.
- `timestamp` (ISO instant) — When the response was generated.

**Possible Errors:**
- `AUTHENTICATION_FAILED` (401) — Missing/invalid/expired JWT.
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` (422) — Text is blank or exceeds 4000 characters.
- `AI_UNAVAILABLE` (503) — AI service is unavailable or returned unparseable output.
